_comment: Manual record of covered evaluator rule-construct cells, the second source of coverage next to the one derived automatically from every docs/testing/*/scenario.json on each run. Add an entry when a cell is exercised by something no manifest limitId can attest (a condition, modifier, repeat or group cell pinned by a scenario, or a module test), or when a cell is deliberately waived. Keys are the pipe-delimited cell keys of scripts/lib/evaluator-coverage-cells.js; docs/testing/worklist.json is regenerated from this file by scripts/evaluator-coverage-inventory.js. An entry may also record a structural axis the cell space does not have (issue 0150): it carries `"key": null` and an `axis` instead of a cell key, so it credits no cell and moves no total, and it exists so the books show what a non-cell invariant attests.

There is no catalogue-derivable semantics for a scenario to pin, so no test can be authored for it.

Die innere or-Gruppe am add-error-Modifikator von 'Tournament rules: Uprising (2026)' (4bc4-8781-2091-d9df, Orcs and Goblins) steckt zwei Ebenen tief: aeussere or-Gruppe > and-Gruppe (instanceOf auf das Kontingent Standard (OG-AB)) > diese or-Gruppe mit zwei greaterThan-1-Mitgliedern (Savage Orc Boar Big 'Uns c679-3389-ca76-2ea1, Stone Trolls 4112-026b-500a-b6fd, scope=roster). Szenario ist gruen.

Das Szenario variiert Budget, Kampagnen-Auswahl und Kontingent so, dass jede Fehl-Lesart sichtbar wird: Roster 03 laesst beide Mitglieder der inneren and-Untergruppe halten (die Negation faellt, die Grenzen schweigen), 04 und 05 lassen je genau eines halten (die Negation haelt, beide Grenzen feuern mit Ist 0 / Grenze 1), 01 keines, und 06 belegt ueber das scheiternde instanceOf, dass die aeussere Klammer unabhaengig davon greift. Szenario ist gruen.

cells.axis: structural placement — the children an entryLink declares itself
cells.rationale: Issue 0150. Deliberately keyless, because what this attests is not a cell: the inventory classifies rule constructs, and 'the carrier is a link that declares its own children' is a structural placement the cell key has no axis for. Only `key` is read by the tooling, so this entry credits no cell, moves no worklist total and raises no stale-covered-key warning. What it records: the corpus invariant derives from the raw XML of both corpora every entryLink that declares its own selectionEntries/selectionEntryGroups/entryLinks — 149 occurrences over the 15 catalogue files of src/evaluator/__fixtures__/whfb6-definitive/ and src/__fixtures__/whfb6/, neither .gst file holding one — and asserts through the facade (prepareDataset + evaluate) that a roster holding such a link gets a report slot for each of its locally declared children under the link's own slot. Those 149 links declare 760 children: 754 are asserted individually by their own report-slot defId, and 6 are recorded as shadowed — the two children of each of the three Forces-of-Chaos 'Battle Standard Bearer' links whose closure reaches the shared 'Magic Banners' target twice, for which the engine emits a single slot, so the pair is asserted as a group and both ids are booked instead. This is the class PR #214 fixed (ownerDefinitionOf dropped the children declared on the link) and that no cell in the inventory could see.
